messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text: behold my model province. total output was always 145% until recently i noticed that in all of my provinces (including this one, which has a ton of education buildings) it fell to 126% exactly, even though nothing changed and no buildings were added or removed. according to the energy balance, the workforce efficiency is now 86% instead of 100%, but no indication is given as to why this happens. this seems to apply universally regardless of how many education buildings there are in a province (i.e. both in provinces with only a few primary schools and in this one with 15, total output is still 126%)

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Well something did happen, you lost over 100m pop or in other words 20% so you no longer have enough people to work

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Population maybe but the majority of deaths would of been working age so you need to wait for your kids to grow up

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Like what is your percentages for each age group

messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text: my percentage for working-age pop is decreasing every day for some reason even though at this point i probably have the most education buildings per capita in the game

messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text: total output has increased slightly since yesterday though, up to (i think) 127%

messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text: which still doesnt match the numbers of graduates im getting

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: Working age people have nothing to do with education. It’s just people within a certain age range
